2610.03467.title: Preserving Anatomical Continuity: Three-Stage Pipeline for Colon Segmentation in 3D Abdominal CT Scans
2610.03467.paper_summary: Accurate colon segmentation from CT images is essential for colorectal disease analysis, yet deep learning based methods often produce disconnected predictions due to complex anatomy. This study introduces a three-stage, topology-preserving segmentation pipeline to address this issue. The first stage performs initial deep learning-based segmentation, followed by centreline bridging to reconnect disjoint regions and a reconstruction stage to refine continuity. Evaluations on TotalSegmentator and RAOS datasets using overlap, distance and topology-based metrics demonstrate improved structural consistency while maintaining segmentation accuracy. The proposed method enhances topological integrity, enabling more reliable colon segmentation for clinical and research applications.
2610.03467.paper_summary_zh: 準確的CT影像結腸分割對於結腸直腸疾病分析至關重要，但基於深度學習的方法常常因為複雜的解剖結構而產生不連貫的預測。本研究提出了一個三階段的拓撲保持分割流程來解決這個問題。第一階段進行初步的基於深度學習的分割，接著進行中心線連接以重新連接不相連的區域，最後是一個重建階段以精煉連續性。對TotalSegmentator和RAOS數據集的評估使用了重疊、距離和基於拓撲的指標，顯示出在保持分割準確性的同時改善了結構一致性。所提出的方法增強了拓撲完整性，使臨床和研究應用中的結腸分割更為可靠。
